# Grafana documentation

> Grafana Labs builds open and composable observability software.

## Documentation home

- [Technical documentation](https://grafana.com/docs.md): Grafana Labs technical documentation landing page.

## Copyright notice
- [Copyright notice](https://grafana.com/docs/copyright-notice.md): Technical documentation for Grafana Labs products and services.

## Grafana Agent Documentation
- [Grafana Agent Documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest.md): Grafana Agent is a telemetry collector for sending metrics, logs, and trace data.
- [Clustering](https://grafana.com/docs/agent/latest/flow/concepts/clustering.md): Learn about Grafana Agent clustering concepts

## Grafana Tempo Documentation
- [Grafana Tempo Documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest.md): Grafana Tempo is a distributed tracing backend.
- [Configuration](https://grafana.com/docs/tempo/latest/configuration.md): Configure Tempo with these settings.
